definitions.full: H8255. sheqel שֶׁ֫קֶל 87 noun masculine Lev 27:6 a weight, shekel (originally = weight ; late Hebrew = coin GACooke Inscr. 356 ); — absolute ׳שׁ Amos 8:5 +, שָׁ֑קֶל Exod 38:29 +; plural שְׁקָלִים Josh 7:21 +; construct שִׁקְלֵי 1Chr 21:25 ; — shekel , as standard weight Amos 8:5 ; of weight of bronze armour 1Sam 17:5 , iron spear-head 17:7 , + 2Sam 21:16 b (see מִשְׁקָל ), hair 14:26 , food Ezek 4:10 ; implying value, of wedge of gold Josh 7:21 (JE); of nails in temple (gold) 2Chr 3:9 ; usually a definite weight of silver (used in payment. or valuation) Exod 21:32 (E), Josh 7:21 (JE), 1Sam 9:8 ; 2Sam 24:24 ; 2Kin 7:1 (twice in verse); 7:16 (twice in verse); 7:18 (twice in verse); 15:20 ; Jer 32:9 ; Ezek 45:12 (twice in verse) (see infra), and ( = coin, from time of Darius I) Neh 5:15 ; 10:33 ; Lev 5:15 ; 27:3-4 , 5 (twice in verse) (all P), +53 t. P; also הַשּׁ ׳מַחֲצִית Exod 30:13 (twice in verse); 30:15 ; 38:26 (= בֶּקַל ), all half-shekel , atonement-money; compare הַשּׁ ׳שְׁלִישִׁית Neh 10:33 one-third ; also שׁ ׳רֶבַע 1Sam 9:8 one-fourth if shekel ; ׳שׁ = 20 גֵּרָה ( ׳ג otherwise unknown) Ezek 45:12 ; Exod 30:13 ; Lev 27:25 ; Num 3:47 ; 50 ׳שׁ = one maneh Ezek 45:12 (read וַחֲמִשִּׁים for וחמשׁה [and עֶשְׂרֵה for עֲשָׂרָה preceding], ᵐ5 A Boeckh Hi-Sm Co Toy Da Krae Berthol); ׳שׁ הַקֹּדֶשׁ Exod 30:13 , 24 ; Lev 5:15 ; Num 3:47 , 50 ; 7:13 21 t. P; land estimated in ׳שׁ of gold 1Chr 21:25 ; ׳שׂ also often omitted after number — ׳שׁ was of two standards, one one-half the other; actual weights (and values) varied, but most persistent were: (1) gold, 252 3-Febgrams Troy (or 126 1/3), modern equivalent approximately £2 1S., or $10; (2) silver, 224 2-Jangrams (nearly 1/2 ounce) = ׳שׁ הַקֹּדֶשׁ (see above), or 112 1/4, modern equivalent approximately 2s. 9d. , or 67 with; ׳שׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּאֶבֶן 2Sam 14:26 is dubious; if late (Bu HPS Löhr Now) it probably reference to a Babylonian or Persian scale (compare S-C pap מלכא באבני often); 60 (or 50) ׳שׁ = 1 mina, 60 minas= 1 talent(see מָנֶה , כִּכָּר ). See especially ARSK Hast. DB WEIGHTS AND MEASURES,and MONEY . תְּקֵל noun [masculine] shekel (see Biblical Hebrew שֶׁקֶל ; תִּקְלָא ᵑ7 ); — absolute ׳ת Dan 5:25 , 27 ; see מְנֵא and references
